v1.description: What happens when a submitter saves their answers: each answered question is written onto the submission, and nothing else changes. This is how filling in a submission stays a workflow rather than a write - the editor posts to the submission itself, and what a save is allowed to do is decided here. The start event admits everyone because the rule that actually matters cannot be written as a performer: it is the *person who raised this particular submission*, which the handler checks against what the engine recorded when it created it. A deployment that lets a coordinator fill requests in on someone's behalf changes that check, not this definition.
